title: SOAP Scanner add-on leads to errors with Java 9+
body:
Split from #2602 (https://github.com/zaproxy/zaproxy/issues/2602#issuecomment-334855554).

The SOAP Scanner is failing with:
```
15374 [ZAP-BootstrapGUI] ERROR org.parosproxy.paros.extension.ExtensionLoader  - javax/xml/soap/SOAPException
```
